fact: CBN reported in February 2026 that Teraco's CT2 Cape Town data centre (50 MW IT load) is connected to a 120 MW solar PV wheeling programme, is designed for a PUE of 1.30 against the company's previous average of 1.47, and aims for a WUE of 0.05 L/kWh with closed-loop cooling.
title: Teraco CT2 expands Cape Town Data Centre capacity now
